reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion puppet materials (matte polymer clay skin, fine mohair hair and goatee, real wire spectacles, authentic woven tweed cap, miniature leather lace-up boots) — AI often replaces with generic 3D CGI or human skin
melancholic hunched sitting posture with drawn-up knees and crossed arms on porch step — AI tends to make characters stand or sit upright smiling

rich miniature diorama textures (miniature dried autumn leaves, weathered timber porch steps, exposed red brick with chipped plaster, turned wooden column) — AI often hallucinates flat procedural textures
warm 3200K autumnal golden-hour lighting with creamy bokeh in the blurred background — AI often introduces harsh digital HDR or oversaturated artificial hues
